comparison_limit: v3 changes both gap policy/estimand and evaluation sample relative to v2; do not report a v3-v2 difference as a one-factor gap effect

compute_budget.stop_behavior: persist partial artifacts and stop; no silent resume or rerun

features.differences: d=1,2,3 recursively applied to log OHLC prices across adjacent observed rows; no raw-price-difference logs
features.feature_availability: completed OHLC data through origin close only; no centered windows and no elapsed-time predictor
features.mixed_moments: population covariance and both oriented third central moments of OHLC observed one-row log changes
features.ohlc_domain: finite, positive and consistent high/low bounds required
features.single_series_moments: mean, central population variance, third central moment, normalized skewness; full trailing observed-transition windows only

folds.purging: train target H24 close strictly before split start; validation decision in [start,end) and H24 target close strictly before end; check every H=1..24 target endpoint obeys the same boundary; this longest-horizon cohort pairs all H

learner.feature_scaler: StandardScaler fit only on current training origins
learner.name: multi-output Ridge
learner.target_scaler: per-output StandardScaler fit only on current training origins; inverse transform before raw-unit metrics

metrics_and_baselines.mean_secondary_baseline: train-mean y_mean fitted on current training origins
metrics_and_baselines.variance_secondary_baseline: ddof=0 variance of latest 16 observed close-to-close transitions available at origin, including gap-crossing transitions
metrics_and_baselines.variance_zero_denominator: skill undefined when baseline MAE is zero
metrics_and_baselines.zero_signs: exact sign {-1,0,+1}; zero correct only if actual and prediction are both exactly zero; report zero counts

revision_reason: User-defined gap contract supersedes v2 strict-gap filtering; v2 remains unchanged and archived.

selection.H1: mean-only; eligible if mean skill vs zero is positive in both inner windows
selection.H_ge_2: eligible only if mean skill vs zero and variance skill vs horizon train-mean are positive in both inner windows
selection.abstention: if no candidate meets threshold, retain fold as abstention and perform no outer refit for that track
selection.frontier: save all-candidate Pareto frontier and separately eligible frontier; no required winner
selection.outer_role: only evaluate a uniquely selected inner procedure; never tune from its score
selection.selected_mean_only: max median mean skill; tie-break fewer features, smaller W, stable mask ID
selection.selected_two_target: maximize min(median mean skill, median variance skill); tie-break fewer features, smaller W, smaller H, stable mask ID
selection.uncertainty: descriptive fold stability only; no inferential test or significance claim because origins/targets overlap

source.source_provenance: previously verified MT5 demo export; this run rehashed only pinned prefix, not full CSV
source.time_semantics: time_utc is bar-open; origin close/decision is open timestamp + 1h; target close is target row open timestamp + 1h

test_status: historical benchmark, not untouched holdout; later test rows must not be read

transition_contract.H1: variance target exactly zero; mean-only track, no epsilon or variance score
transition_contract.elapsed_audit: input history duration, target duration, non-one-hour transition counts stored as metadata only; no cause attribution
transition_contract.feature_gap_handling: OHLC log-price transitions, cross-price ratios/differences, univariate moments and mixed moments use adjacent observed rows including gaps; no calendar-time rescaling
transition_contract.future_metadata: future target timestamp, elapsed hours and gap-crossing status are label/audit metadata only, never model features
transition_contract.gap_predictor: fixed core feature log(open_i/close_(i-1)) for the current observed transition; one uniquely named feature
transition_contract.history: W latest adjacent observed completed H1 transitions, requiring W+1 observed rows/closes; history never resets on time gaps
transition_contract.missing_intervals: retain adjacent source rows across all closures/missing intervals; no row dropped for a gap; no interpolation
transition_contract.return: r_j=log(C[i+j]/C[i+j-1]); no division by elapsed calendar time
transition_contract.target: H next adjacent observed H1 transitions, H=1..24
transition_contract.target_variance: mean((r_j-y_mean)^2), ddof=0; realized within-horizon dispersion, not predictive uncertainty

window_horizon_grid.common_origin_rule: row>=96 and row+24<10621; same origin rows for every W/H/mask; per split also require the common H24 target endpoint before the split boundary
